name: Multispecies LC-MS/MS Benchmark
description: A multispecies benchmark and validation dataset/protocol for assessing LC-MS/MS performance in bottom-up proteomics experiments.
reputation: A specialized, domain-specific benchmark used by proteomics groups for LC-MS/MS method validation; moderate adoption in the proteomics community.
notes: Multi‑species design increases complexity; performance depends strongly on instrument/setup and search parameters. Limited to LC‑MS/MS bottom‑up experiments (non‑LLM), potential small/heterogeneous validation subsets and sample‑specific biases.
